items.title_en: Mistral raises €3B
items.title_zh: Mistral筹集30亿欧元，推动主权与开放权重的AI成为技术前沿
items.summary_en: Mistral AI has raised 3 billion euros to push sovereign, open-weight AI to the tech frontier. The goal is to enable organizations to run competitive, state-of-the-art models in a sovereign stack, potentially reducing reliance on big cloud providers. The funding signals strong investor appetite for open-weight approaches as geopolitics and security concerns reshape AI infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: Mistral宣布募集30亿欧元，旨在通过主权与开放权重的AI将技术前沿推向自有基础设施。目标是让组织能够在自主、合规的环境中运行高水平模型，降低对大型云厂商的依赖。此次融资凸显投资方对开放权重路线在地缘政治与安全考虑下的兴趣。

items.title_en: Among European Companies That Use a CDN, Nearly 9 in 10 Use Cloudflare
items.title_zh: 在使用CDN的欧洲企业中，近九成依赖Cloudflare
items.summary_en: Cloudflare dominates the European CDN landscape, signaling high vendor concentration as edge delivery becomes essential for digital services. This raises questions about resilience, privacy, and regulatory scrutiny when a single vendor handles a large share of traffic and security services.
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare在欧洲CDN领域占据主导地位，随着边缘交付成为数字服务的关键部分，市场高度集中引发对韧性、隐私与监管的关注。单一供应商对大量流量与安全服务的控制，可能带来潜在风险与依赖性问题。

items.title_en: Navier-Stokes – Tristan Buckmaster [pdf]
items.title_zh: Navier–Stokes 方程 — Tristan Buckmaster [PDF]
items.summary_en: A technical PDF by Tristan Buckmaster on the Navier–Stokes equations, offering mathematical detail and potential new insights. The Navier–Stokes problem sits at the intersection of analysis and physics, with long-standing open questions about existence and smoothness that drive recent research.
items.summary_zh: Tristan Buckmaster 的这份 PDF 针对 Navier–Stokes 方程，提供数学细节与潜在的新见解。Navier–Stokes 问题在分析与物理的交叉领域备受关注，其关于存在性与光滑性的长期未解问题推动了近期的研究工作。

items.title_en: We have a year to fix security everywhere
items.title_zh: 我们只有一年时间解决各处的安全问题
items.summary_en: An urgent call to overhaul security across systems within one year, outlining high-priority actions like patching, hardening defaults, and supply-chain verification. The post argues that incremental fixes won't suffice and highlights cross-team coordination and measurable milestones.
items.summary_zh: 一项一年前瞻的行动呼吁，强调在一年内覆盖所有系统的安全整改，重点包括打补丁、加强默认配置和供应链验证等。文章强调需要跨团队协作和可量化的里程碑来确保落地。

items.title_en: Jellyfin 12.0
items.title_zh: Jellyfin 12.0
items.summary_en: Jellyfin 12.0 marks a new release for the open-source media server, likely with UI improvements, performance tweaks, and new client/server features. The update continues to emphasize privacy-friendly, self-hosted media streaming.
items.summary_zh: Jellyfin 12.0 作为开源媒体服务器的最新版本，带来界面改进、性能优化和新特性。该更新延续了自托管、注重隐私的媒体流体验。

items.title_en: I've factored the RSA keys of a Certificate Authority from the 90s
items.title_zh: 我已经分解了90年代某证书颁发机构的 RSA 密钥
items.summary_en: Factoring a 1990s-era CA RSA key underscores how legacy cryptography remains a risk. The disclosure prompts re-issuance of certificates under stronger keys, revocation considerations, and a push toward modern algorithms and shorter key lifetimes.
items.summary_zh: 对90年代某证书颁发机构的 RSA 密钥进行分解，揭示了旧式加密的长期风险。此事可能推动重新颁发证书、吊销受影响的证书，并促使向更强的算法和更短的密钥寿命过渡。

items.title_en: Why getting your hands dirty is good for you
items.title_zh: 为什么动手做对你有益的原因
items.summary_en: Engaging in hands-on activities yields tangible health and cognitive benefits within weeks, from mood boosts to increased resilience and activity. The piece argues that tactile, messy work can enhance learning and well-being rather than hinder it.
items.summary_zh: 动手实践在数周内就能带来明显的健康与认知收益，包括情绪提升、韧性增强与身体活动增加。文章指出，动手的实际操作有助于学习与身心健康，而非削弱它们。

items.title_en: My Feed, My Way
items.title_zh: 我的信息流，我的选择
items.summary_en: Policy proposal giving Australians more control over their feeds, with transparency around algorithms and opt-out options. It highlights the government's effort to empower citizens to shape what they see online while balancing privacy and information diversity.
items.summary_zh: 政府提出让用户掌控信息流的政策，强调透明度、可定制化及可选择退出的权利。旨在在隐私与信息多样性之间取得平衡，并让公民能更主动地管理所见内容。

items.title_en: There's a new "Google Jail" for independent wikis
items.title_zh: 独立维基的新型“Google Jail”
items.summary_en: Independent wikis are facing new restrictions or demotion in Google search, dubbed a 'Google Jail' scenario.
items.summary_zh: 独立维基在谷歌搜索中的可见性遭遇新的限制，被形容为‘Google Jail’。文章分析搜索索引变动如何影响社区成长与曝光，以及小型项目需要如何适应平台的排名机制。

items.title_en: Antiquated HTML Snippets and Artefacts
items.title_zh: 陈旧的HTML片段与遗留痕迹
items.summary_en: Older HTML fragments still show up in modern projects, complicating accessibility and maintenance. Auditing, modernizing tooling, and stricter coding practices help reduce bloat and improve long-term stability.
items.summary_zh: 现代项目中仍存在陈旧的HTML片段，增加无障碍性与维护难度。通过审计、现代化工具和更严格的编码规范，可以减少臃肿、提升长期稳定性。

items.title_en: TALA Is Open-Source
items.title_zh: TALA 开源了
items.summary_en: TALA is now open-source, inviting community contributions and transparent collaboration. The release likely includes source code, documentation, and examples that accelerate adoption and enable peer review.
items.summary_zh: TALA 已宣布开源，欢迎社区贡献和透明协作。开源版本通常包含源代码、文档和示例，能加速采用并便于同行评审。

items.title_en: Keep Our Servers Running
items.title_zh: 确保服务器持续运行
items.summary_en: Archive.org launches a September fundraising push that triples the impact of recurring donations, helping sustain its archival servers and services. The initiative shows how regular gifts can scale funding for long-term reliability of public digital archives.
items.summary_zh: Archive.org 在九月发起募集活动，定期捐款的影响将放大三倍，以维持档案服务器与相关服务的运行。文章解释了持续捐赠如何放大资金规模、提升长期可靠性。

items.title_en: Watch Los Angeles get built, one building at a time (1880–2026)
items.title_zh: 洛杉矶天际线演变：从1880年到2026年，一座建筑的崛起
items.summary_en: An immersive visualization charts Los Angeles' skyline growth from 1880 to 2026, highlighting how waves of development reshaped the city. It provides a data-driven lens on urban growth, illustrating how policy, infrastructure, and housing booms interact to mold a modern megacity.
items.summary_zh: 通过数据驱动的时间序列可视化，展现洛杉矶自1880年以来的天际线如何在多轮开发中持续扩张。该作品揭示了政策、基础设施和住房繁荣如何共同作用，塑造了这座现代大都会的演变轨迹。

items.title_en: I tested 10 model/harness combinations on the same Three.js task
items.title_zh: 我在同一 Three.js 任务上测试了 10 种模型/ harness 组合
items.summary_en: Benchmarking ten model/harness combinations on a Three.js task reveals how rendering performance and stability vary with toolchains. The results help developers select appropriate models and harnesses for real-time 3D in the browser, and highlight trade-offs between speed, memory, and accuracy.
items.summary_zh: 在同一 Three.js 任务上对十种模型与 harness 组合进行基准测试，揭示了不同工具链对渲染性能与稳定性的影响。结果为开发者在浏览器中实现实时3D时选择合适的模型与 harness 提供了参考，并揭示了速度、内存与精度之间的权衡。

items.title_en: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
items.title_zh: 多代理LLM金融交易框架
items.summary_en: A modular framework enables multiple LLM agents to coordinate trading decisions, potentially expanding automated strategies beyond single-model limits. It unlocks speed and diversification but also raises risk management, reproducibility, and regulatory considerations.
items.summary_zh: 一个模块化框架允许多名LLM代理协同进行交易决策，理论上扩展了自动化策略的边界。它带来更高的速度与策略多样性，同时也带来风险管理、可重复性与监管方面的挑战。

items.title_en: How well do agents use test/verification techniques?
items.title_zh: 代理如何高效使用测试/验证技术？
items.summary_en: This piece examines how AI agents leverage test and verification techniques, highlighting current gaps, practical tooling, and evaluation metrics. It argues that reliable verification remains hard, requiring systematic approaches to ensure outputs are trustworthy.
items.summary_zh: 文章探讨 AI 代理在测试与验证技术方面的应用，指出现有工具与评估方法的不足，以及实现可验证性所面临的挑战。文章强调需要系统性的方法来提升输出的可信度与鲁棒性。

items.title_en: bzip3
items.title_zh: bzip3：新一代无损压缩格式
items.summary_en: bzip3 is a new lossless compression format designed to outperform existing algorithms like bz2 in speed and compression ratio. It aims to integrate with existing tooling and influence archival and software distribution.
items.summary_zh: bzip3 是一种新型无损压缩格式，目标是在速度与压缩比方面优于 bz2 等现有算法。它设计为兼容现有工具链，有望影响归档和软件分发的效率。

items.title_en: Leaving VMware just got harder after Broadcom pulled VDDK downloads
items.title_zh: Broadcom 下架 VDDK 下载后，离开 VMware 更难
items.summary_en: Broadcom has pulled down VMware VDDK downloads, complicating exit strategies for customers looking to move away from VMware. VDDK (Virtual Disk Development Kit) underpins many backup, migration, and management tools, and losing easy access raises the cost and friction of departing a VMware-centric stack. Expect longer migration timelines and potential reevaluation of vendor dependencies.
items.summary_zh: Broadcom 下架 VDDK 下载后，退出 VMware 的难度进一步上升。VDDK 是与 VMware 集成的关键工具之一，此举可能提高迁移成本并增加对原厂工具的依赖。

items.title_en: Show HN: Stuxnet – A reconstructed source code of the infamous cyber-weapon
items.title_zh: Show HN：Stuxnet——臭名昭著网络武器的重建源码
items.summary_en: A portion of Stuxnet's source code has been reconstructed and published on GitHub, offering researchers a rare peek into the malware's inner workings. The release illuminates the malware's modular design, multi-stage propagation, and PLC targeting that made it historically sophisticated. For security teams, it serves as a concrete reference point for building defenses and understanding exploit chains.
items.summary_zh: 公开了一部分 Stuxnet 的重建源码，研究者可以通过该代码更深入理解这起臭名昭著的网络武器的实现。发布揭示了该木马的模块化设计、分阶段传播及对 PLC 的定向攻击等要点，为防御研究提供了参考。

items.title_en: 216M Spy TVs – The LG Smart TV Problem [video]
items.title_zh: 216M Spy TVs：LG 智能电视问题（视频）
items.summary_en: A video claims LG smart TVs expose users to privacy risks, with hundreds of millions of devices affected. It covers firmware, telemetry, and app behavior, and suggests practical steps to mitigate risk.
items.summary_zh: 视频声称 LG 智能电视存在隐私风险，涉及数亿设备可能被监控或数据泄露。内容分析固件、遥测和应用行为，并提出降低风险的实际建议。

items.title_en: Arm Mali G2-Ultra NX GPU: desktop-class mobile gameplay with AI-native graphics
items.title_zh: Arm Mali G2-Ultra NX GPU：具AI原生图形的移动端桌面级游戏体验
items.summary_en: The Mali G2-Ultra NX aims to deliver desktop-class gaming visuals on mobile, powered by AI-native graphics pipelines. This shift pushes mobile engines toward richer rendering and on-device AI workloads, with implications for developers and power efficiency.
items.summary_zh: Mali G2-Ultra NX 旨在在移动设备上实现桌面级游戏画质，并通过AI原生图形管线驱动。此举推动移动引擎在渲染质量与本地AI工作负载方面更进一步，对开发者和能耗管理提出新挑战。

items.title_en: Emacs Bedrock 2.0
items.title_zh: Emacs Bedrock 2.0
items.summary_en: Emacs Bedrock 2.0 updates the editor experience with streamlined startup, better defaults, and ergonomic improvements for power users. The release likely focuses on performance tuning and a more approachable onboarding for new users.
items.summary_zh: Emacs Bedrock 2.0 对编辑器体验进行更新，提供更快启动、改进的默认设置以及更友好的高效工作体验。新版本关注性能优化与新手友好引导。

items.title_en: The VMs Powering Mobile Agents (Instinct, Claude Code)
items.title_zh: 推动移动代理的虚拟机（Instinct、Claude Code）
items.summary_en: Virtual machines powering mobile agents like Instinct and Claude Code enable on-device reasoning and privacy-preserving computation. They move edge AI forward but raise concerns about resource use and security.
items.summary_zh: 用于移动代理的虚拟机（如Instinct和Claude Code）使设备端推理与隐私保护成为现实，推动边缘AI的发展，同时也引发资源分配与安全性方面的担忧。

items.title_en: Live map of public transport in Belgium
items.title_zh: 比利时实时公共交通地图
items.summary_en: Belgium now offers a live map that aggregates real-time public transit feeds for buses, trams, and trains. The tool helps commuters plan routes more reliably and provides a data source for developers building mobility apps.
items.summary_zh: 比利时推出实时公共交通地图，汇集公交、轻轨和铁路的实时信息。该地图有助于出行计划更高效，并为开发者提供潜在的数据源来构建出行应用。

items.title_en: Macbeth and His Problems
items.title_zh: 麦克白及其难题
items.summary_en: An essay reexamines Macbeth, unpacking ambition, guilt, and the psychology of tyranny in a modern context. It argues that the play's moral ambiguity and political scrutiny remain relevant to today’s leadership and power dynamics.
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文重新审视麦克白，剖析野心、罪疚感与暴政的心理机制在现代语境中的意义。作者认为剧中对道德模糊性和权力压力的刻画，至今仍与当下的领导力与权力结构共鸣。

items.title_en: Icy Moons Are Ocean Worlds
items.title_zh: 冰冷的月球其实是海洋世界
items.summary_en: Icy moons are ocean worlds beneath icy crusts, with subsurface oceans likely driving geology and potential habitats. The piece explains why these moons are prime targets for future missions and astrobiology. It underscores the implications for life beyond Earth and exploration tech.
items.summary_zh: 冰冷的卫星在冰壳下可能拥有地下海洋，是天体生物学的重要目标。文章解释了为何这些月球成为未来探测与研究的重点对象，强调了寻找地外生命的可能性及相关探测技术的挑战。

items.title_en: Run an ArchiveTeam Warrior on your computer
items.title_zh: 在你的电脑上运行ArchiveTeam Warrior
items.summary_en: ArchiveTeam Warrior enables volunteers to contribute to digital preservation by running a client on their own computer to help capture old websites and artifacts. It distributes archival work across the community beyond centralized efforts.
items.summary_zh: ArchiveTeam Warrior 允许志愿者在本地计算机上运行客户端，帮助收集旧网站与资料，推动数字遗产保护的分布式协作，扩展了中心化方法之外的保存能力。

items.title_en: The Dataflow Model Revisited
items.title_zh: 重访数据流模型
items.summary_en: The paper revisits the dataflow computation model to clarify operator semantics, state handling, and composability for modern streaming and batch systems. By formalizing dataflow primitives and execution expectations, it aims to help system builders reason about correctness, latency, and fault recovery across distributed data-processing engines.
items.summary_zh: 该论文对数据流计算模型进行了重新梳理，阐明了算子语义、状态处理和可组合性，以适应现代流式与批处理系统的需求。通过形式化数据流的基本原语和执行预期，旨在帮助系统设计者在分布式数据处理引擎中更好地推理正确性、延迟和容错恢复。

items.title_en: Trusting-Trust Attack against an Entire Linux Distribution
items.title_zh: 针对整个 Linux 发行版的信任-信任攻击
items.summary_en: Researchers demonstrate a Trusting-Trust style attack that could compromise every package in a Linux distribution, revealing how supply chain trust scales to an OS. The work amplifies needs for reproducible builds, verifiable toolchains, and better supply-chain defenses.
items.summary_zh: 研究者展示一种信任-信任攻击，理论上可能破坏 Linux 发行版中的每个软件包，凸显供应链信任在整个操作系统层面的脆弱性。该工作推动对可复现构建、可验证工具链以及更完善的供应链防御的重视。

items.title_en: This Month in Ladybird – August 2026
items.title_zh: 本月 Ladybird（2026 年 8 月）
items.summary_en: This August 2026 issue highlights new children's titles, author spotlights, and inclusive education initiatives from Ladybird. It reflects how a traditional publisher evolves with contemporary topics while preserving its brand of accessible storytelling.
items.summary_zh: 本期 2026 年 8 月的 Ladybird 期刊聚焦新书发布、作者专访以及包容性教育计划，展示该出版社在保持易懂故事性的同时，与现代议题保持对话的演变。

items.title_en: We built our house for LAN parties
items.title_zh: 为LAN派对而建的家
items.summary_en: A house designed for LAN parties doubles as a testbed for high-speed networking, power distribution, and cooling in a home setting. The project offers practical lessons for building home labs and gaming-infrastructure in real homes.
items.summary_zh: 这座为LAN派对而建的房子成了在家庭环境中测试高速网络、供电与散热的实验场。该项目为在家中搭建自带娱乐与实验基础设施的可行做法提供了实用经验。

items.title_en: Scientists observe Einstein's gravity in the quantum world
items.title_zh: 科学家在量子世界观察到爱因斯坦引力效应
items.summary_en: Researchers demonstrate gravitational effects consistent with general relativity within a quantum system, bridging quantum mechanics and gravity. This experimental step sharpens questions about quantum gravity and how spacetime might behave at small scales.
items.summary_zh: 研究者在量子系统中观测到符合广义相对论的引力效应， bridging 量子力学与引力之间的关系。这一实验性进展提出关于量子引力以及时空在微观尺度上如何运作的关键问题。

items.title_en: WeatherNext 3
items.title_zh: WeatherNext 3：天气预测的最新进展
items.summary_en: DeepMind's WeatherNext 3 advances AI-assisted weather forecasting, beating previous benchmarks on forecasting accuracy and uncertainty quantification. The update demonstrates AI's growing role in meteorology and could tighten predictions for extreme weather events.
items.summary_zh: DeepMind 的 WeatherNext 3 提升了 AI 辅助天气预测的准确性与不确定性量化，刷新了此前的基准。该进展显示人工智能在气象学中的应用日益广泛，可能提高极端天气预警的可靠性。

items.title_en: Simple Is Not Small
items.title_zh: 简单≠小
items.summary_en: Simplicity in design or API does not automatically translate to a small binary, low resource use, or minimal operational surface; the trade-offs that yield simple interfaces can hide complexity or bloat elsewhere. Effective engineering requires naming which constraints matter — simplicity for users, smallness for embedded targets, or minimal attack surface — and optimizing explicitly for that goal.
items.summary_zh: 设计或接口的简单性并不等同于二进制小、资源占用低或运行时开销小；为用户提供简单体验的权衡可能会把复杂性或膨胀转移到别处。工程实践需要明确哪种约束更重要——用户简洁、嵌入式的小体积或最小攻击面——并有针对性地优化。

items.title_en: Understanding Computer Memory Architecture and SSD Internals
items.title_zh: 理解计算机内存架构与SSD内部结构
items.summary_en: This overview explains how data travels from CPU caches and DRAM to storage, and why SSD internals influence latency, endurance, and throughput. Grasping these details helps optimize performance and reliability.
items.summary_zh: 本概览讲解数据如何在CPU缓存、DRAM和存储之间流动，以及SSD内部结构如何影响延迟、耐久性与吞吐。掌握这些细节有助于从系统与应用层面优化性能与可靠性。

items.title_en: Decoding the NEC V20 Microcode
items.title_zh: 解码 NEC V20 微代码
items.summary_en: Reverse-engineering of the NEC V20's microcode uncovers implementation details and subtle differences from Intel-compatible behavior, illuminating instruction decoding and microarchitectural quirks. Those findings help explain compatibility anomalies and are useful for preservation, emulation, and understanding historical CPU design trade-offs.
items.summary_zh: 对 NEC V20 微代码的逆向分析揭示了实现细节以及与 Intel 兼容行为的细微差异，说明了指令解码和微架构上的特性。相关发现有助于解释兼容性异常，并对硬件保存、仿真以及理解历史 CPU 设计权衡具有参考价值。

items.title_en: Show HN: Jigsaw Haiku
items.title_zh: Show HN：Jigsaw Haiku
items.summary_en: A Show HN project titled Jigsaw Haiku presents an intriguing blend of puzzle-like mechanics and poetry generation. It showcases a compact, creative idea worthy of community feedback and exploration.
items.summary_zh: Show HN 展示的 Jigsaw Haiku 展现了拼图式机制与诗歌创作的有趣融合，体现了一个紧凑而具有创造性的点子，值得社区参与和探索。

items.title_en: Show HN: Interactive Tree of Life
items.title_zh: Show HN：互动式生命之树
items.summary_en: Interactive Tree of Life presents an interactive visualization of biological taxonomy, enabling users to explore relationships from broad groups to species. The project demonstrates how scalable frontend tech can render vast hierarchical data with search, filtering, and navigation tools. It's a useful example for biology education and data visualization on the web.
items.summary_zh: Interactive Tree of Life 提供一个可交互的生命之树可视化，允许用户浏览从大类到物种的系统发育关系并进行搜索与过滤。该项目展示了大规模分级数据在前端的可视化实现，以及在教育和研究中的潜在应用。

items.title_en: John Margolies' photographs of roadside America
items.title_zh: 约翰·马格洛利斯的路边美国摄影作品
items.summary_en: John Margolies’ roadside America photographs capture a bygone era of American road culture and signage, now archived and celebrated for design history and cultural memory. The collection informs interface design, travel UI, and the aesthetics of mid-20th-century commerce.
items.summary_zh: 约翰·马格洛利斯的路边美国摄影记录了过去的美式公路文化、路牌与景观，如今被整理成珍贵的设计史与文化记忆。该收藏为界面设计、旅行相关 UI 以及20世纪中期商业美学提供素材。

items.title_en: Whistle Synth Mac App
items.title_zh: 口哨合成器（Whistle Synth）
items.summary_en: Whistle Synth is a compact Mac app that generates whistle-like tones with controls for pitch and timbre, aimed at quick sound design or musical experimentation. Its lightweight interface makes it suitable for sketching melodic ideas or adding a distinctive whistle texture without heavy audio toolchains.
items.summary_zh: Whistle Synth 是一款小巧的 Mac 应用，用于合成口哨类音色，并提供音高与音色控制，便于快速做声音设计或音乐试验。它的轻量界面适合快速勾勒旋律创意或在不使用复杂音频工具链的情况下加入独特的口哨质感。

items.title_en: Finding a bug in Dummit and Foote's Abstract Algebra
items.title_zh: 在《Dummit and Foote》的抽象代数中发现一个错误
items.summary_en: Someone spots a flaw in a classic abstract algebra textbook, triggering discussion on errata and the rigor of proofs. The find highlights how even classic references can harbor subtle mistakes and invites community verification.
items.summary_zh: 有人在经典抽象代数教材中发现一个错误，引发关于勘错与证明严谨性的讨论。这一发现凸显了即使是权威教材也可能存在细微错误，需要社区共同核对以确保数学准确性。

items.title_en: Every novel is boring until it isn't
items.title_zh: 每本小说在还没读透前都显得无聊，直到它变得引人入胜
items.summary_en: An essay argues that novels often reveal their appeal only after sustained engagement, challenging first impressions and encouraging deeper reading.
items.summary_zh: 一篇文章主张小说常常在持续阅读后才显现魅力，挑战初印象并鼓励读者深入阅读。

items.title_en: Methods for Random Gradients (2024)
items.title_zh: 2024 年的随机梯度方法
items.summary_en: A survey of methods for random gradients in 2024 surveys how injecting or leveraging gradient randomness can improve optimization, aiding exploration and preventing premature convergence. It discusses practical takeaways for training robust models.
items.summary_zh: 2024 年的随机梯度方法综述评估了在优化过程中引入或利用梯度随机性的策略，帮助提高探索性并避免过早收敛。面向机器学习从业者，给出可操作的实践要点。

items.title_en: Colorlight 5A-75B: A dive into a popular low-cost ECP5 (FPGA) development board
items.title_zh: Colorlight 5A-75B：入门级低成本 ECP5 FPGA 开发板深度解析
items.summary_en: Colorlight 5A-75B is a popular, affordable FPGA development board based on ECP5; the post dives into its pinout, onboard peripherals, and practical projects. It highlights why this board is a go-to for hobbyists and students exploring FPGA design on a budget.
items.summary_zh: Colorlight 5A-75B 是基于 ECP5 的流行低成本 FPGA 开发板，文章深入解析其引脚、外设与实用案例，说明为何它成为爱好者和学生入门 FPGA 设计的首选之一。

items.title_en: She Also Found It at the Movies
items.title_zh: 她也在电影里找到了它
items.summary_en: An essay analyzing how cinema reveals or resonates with certain ideas or experiences, including how viewers encounter meaning beyond the screen.
items.summary_zh: 这篇随笔探讨电影如何成为揭示意涵的场域，以及观众在银幕之外所触及的意义。

items.title_en: Extinct Tasmanian tiger's 'snap' unlike any living mammal's bite
items.title_zh: 灭绝的袋虎的咬合力与现存哺乳动物截然不同
items.summary_en: New paleontological work on the thylacine reveals bite mechanics that differ from living mammals, suggesting unusual jaw design and feeding strategies. These biomechanical insights shed light on its ecological role and evolution.
items.summary_zh: 对袋虎的新考古学研究显示其咬合力与现存哺乳动物不同，暗示其颚部结构与进食策略存在独特性。这些生物力学发现有助于理解其生态角色与进化路径。

items.title_en: Feather Atlas
items.title_zh: 羽毛图鉴
items.summary_en: Feather Atlas is a government resource for identifying bird feathers, aiding birders, researchers, and forensic investigators. It also emphasizes legal restrictions around collecting or possessing feathers from protected species.
items.summary_zh: 羽毛图鉴是政府提供的羽毛识别资源，帮助观鸟爱好者、研究人员和取证分析者使用，同时强调对受保护物种羽毛的收藏与持有的法律限制。

items.title_en: anystation: Calling any station A public board shaped like a tree. No account
items.title_zh: anystation：一个树状公开看板，免账户
items.summary_en: anystation offers a public, account-free board shaped like a tree, inviting anonymous posting and collaboration. The design lowers barriers but raises moderation and information-organization questions for communities.
items.summary_zh: anystation 提供一个树状结构的公开看板，用户无需账户即可发帖与协作。该设计降低了进入门槛，但也带来社区治理与信息组织方面的挑战。

items.title_en: End-to-end infrastructure for training and inferencing open weight models
items.title_zh: 用于训练与推理开源权重模型的端到端基础设施
items.summary_en: An end-to-end infra stack for training and serving open-weight models enables reproducible, scalable AI work. It covers data pipelines, training, inference, and deployment, helping researchers and startups experiment with open weights more efficiently.
items.summary_zh: 端到端的基础设施栈支持训练与推理开源权重模型，提升可重复性与可扩展性。该体系涵盖数据管线、训练、推理与部署，帮助研究者与初创团队更高效地开展开权模型实验。

items.title_en: Robot writes in languages it has never seen before
items.title_zh: 机器人用未曾接触过的语言写作
items.summary_en: Robots can generate text in languages they were not explicitly trained on by leveraging cross-lingual generalization and emergent model capabilities. This demonstrates how robotics may communicate and learn beyond its training data.
items.summary_zh: 机器人能够利用跨语言泛化与涌现能力，在没有明确训练的语言中创作文本，展示了机器人在超出训练数据范围内沟通与学习的潜力。
